Portable PowerShell 7.6.5 parsed the launcher and its StaticSelfTest reproduced the exact vendored-addon digest; Windows PowerShell 5.1 validation is configured in CI but is not promoted before the exact-head workflow result.
Isolated Godot 4.7.1 Linux headless import and parse passed; Godot AI reported its expected headless-only server disablement.
Existing GUT regression suite passed 50/50 tests with 355 assertions, including the strict log guard.
rollback_procedure: Disable the editor plugin, remove addons/godot_ai and its project.godot entry, then delete the dedicated Godot-Tetris-4.7.1 and .codex-tetris directories after confirming no Tetris process is running.
